# Capture & Connect

> A Netherlands-based content, social media and web studio for artists, festivals
> and brands. Founded and led by Ryan van der Niet. Everything we claim on the
> site links to a public source you can open yourself.

Working across the Netherlands, Belgium and beyond. All copy on the site is in
English. Contact: info@captureandconnect.nl. KvK 90315790, VAT NL004804916B78.

## Services

- **Content creation** — liveshots and multicam recording, event films and
  aftermovies, artist promos and brand visuals, short-form built to perform.
  https://captureandconnect.nl/services/#content-creation
- **Social media management** — content planning and strategy, Instagram,
  TikTok and YouTube, community and engagement, monthly performance tracking.
  https://captureandconnect.nl/services/#social-media-management
- **Web design and strategy** — custom design and development, mobile-first,
  SEO and performance, landing pages, domain and hosting handled.
  https://captureandconnect.nl/services/#web-design

## Proof (all publicly verifiable)

- One artist promo reel past 20 million views, no paid boost — The Dope Doctor:
  https://www.instagram.com/reel/DKcUyZgog7I/
- Official Ground Zero Festival 2025 aftermovie on YouTube:
  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wMICv0W9h8o
- Hairmoment, a salon site taken from sketch to live in two weeks:
  https://hairmoment.nl/
- Event archive with the artists filmed at each event, each linking to the
  public post: https://captureandconnect.nl/portfolio/#content-creation
- Managed accounts, nine live across Instagram and TikTok:
  https://captureandconnect.nl/portfolio/#social-media

## Recent event work (2026)

Rebirth Festival (Haaren, 10 April), Paaspop (Schijndel, 3 April), Masters Of
Hardcore (Den Bosch, 28 March), Reverze (Antwerp, 27 February), Masters Of
Hardcore Austria (St. Polten, 14 February), BKJN vs Partyraiser (Zoetermeer,
31 January).
